title: 12-week strongman RPE pyramid with AMRAP top sets
summary: Four days a week: log, deadlift, squat, and upper back. Main lifts use one AMRAP top set in work weeks, then fixed backoff sets.
rationale: The main lifts wave through six-, five-, and three-rep minimums. The AMRAP top set stops by RPE 9 or when technique slips. Pivot and deload weeks stay easy. Add a small amount of load in the next matching wave only when reps improve without passing the cap. If deadlift AMRAP work hurts the next squat day, cap deadlift at RPE 8-8.5 or stop at the minimum reps.
goals: Keep log, deadlift, and back squat as the measurable priorities.
Protect the lower back and fit sessions into 45–60 minutes.
Use the AMRAP top set to measure progress without grinding to failure.
assumptions: This is a general strongman block without a dated contest or required carry event.
Equipment includes a log, barbell, rack, bench, Slingshot, and stable low-cable row setup.
The top set and backoffs count as working sets; warm-up ramps do not.
AMRAP applies only to the top set in work weeks; stop by RPE 9 and leave about one rep in reserve.

days.title: Log Clean + Press
days.focus: Focused lift, support, then accessory; cut accessory work first if time runs long.

exercises.name: Log clean and press - clean every rep
exercises.prescription: Ramp 5 @ RPE 6, 3-5 @ RPE 7; top 1 x 6+ AMRAP @ RPE 8-9; backoff 2 x 6 @ RPE 7-8.
exercises.reason: Practice the clean and press with the contest implement.
exercises.note: Clean every rep. Top set is RPE-capped; lower load for backoffs. No singles. AMRAP only on the top set: start with a load that puts the minimum reps near the listed RPE; stop by RPE 9 or when form breaks. If you miss the minimum, reduce load next time. Backoffs are fixed.
exercises.cue: Brace before the press and keep the implement close through the clean.
alternatives: Axle clean and press when the log is unavailable

exercises.name: Raw flat bench press
exercises.prescription: Raw flat bench 3 x 6-8 @ RPE 7-8.
exercises.reason: Build the bench without taking work away from the event lift.
exercises.note: Bench raw after log. Keep enough in reserve for Day 3 and Day 4 pressing.

exercises.name: Cable face pull/rear fly
exercises.prescription: Cable face pull or rear fly 2-3 x 12-20 @ RPE 7-8; optional cable curl.
exercises.reason: Train the rear delts. Cut this first if time is short.
exercises.note: Use the single-stack pulley; cut this slot first if time runs long.

days.title: Deadlift Priority

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.prescription: Ramp 5 @ RPE 6, 3-5 @ RPE 7; top 1 x 6+ AMRAP @ RPE 8-9; backoff 2 x 6 @ RPE 7-8.
exercises.reason: Pull heavy. Keep the deadlift moving.
exercises.note: Top set is RPE-capped. Preserve lower-back recovery for Day 4; no singles. exercises.name: Optional cable pressdown/rear fly
